R: General Residential District - promotes diverse housing opportunities and preserves neighborhood character, allowing compatible nonresidential uses.
RS1: Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District - large-lot detached houses; minimum lot 6,250 sq ft; FAR 0.50.
RS2: Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District - detached houses; minimum lot 5,000 sq ft; FAR 0.65.
RS3: Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District - detached houses; minimum lot 2,500 sq ft; FAR 0.90.
RT3.5: Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District - detached houses, two-flats, townhouses, and low-density multi-unit buildings; FAR 1.05.
RT4: Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District - mix of housing types with higher density than RT3.5; FAR 1.20.
RM4.5: Residential Multi-Unit District - transition between RT4 and RM5, primarily accommodating multi-unit buildings; FAR 1.70.
RM5: Residential Multi-Unit District - multi-unit residential up to 4 stories; FAR 2.00.
RM5.5: Residential Multi-Unit District - multi-unit residential up to 5 stories; FAR 2.50.
RM6: Residential Multi-Unit District - high-density mid-rise and high-rise residential; FAR 4.40.
RM6.5: Residential Multi-Unit District - high-density high-rise residential; FAR 6.60.
B1-1: Neighborhood Shopping District - small-scale retail and service uses, pedestrian-oriented; residential allowed above ground floor.
B1-1.5: Neighborhood Shopping District - variant with adjusted bulk/density; residential allowed above ground floor.
B1-2: Neighborhood Shopping District - variant with higher bulk; residential above ground floor.
B1-3: Neighborhood Shopping District - variant with greater bulk; residential above ground floor.
B1-5: Neighborhood Shopping District - highest intensity in B1 range; residential above ground floor.
B2-1: Neighborhood Mixed-Use District - allows ground-floor residential; stimulates underdeveloped streets.
B2-1.5: Neighborhood Mixed-Use District - adjusted bulk/density variant; residential on or above ground floor.
B2-2: Neighborhood Mixed-Use District - variant with higher bulk; residential on or above ground floor.
B2-3: Neighborhood Mixed-Use District - higher density mixed-use; residential on or above ground floor.
B2-5: Neighborhood Mixed-Use District - highest intensity mixed-use; residential on or above ground floor.
B3-1: Community Shopping District - broad retail/service uses; destination-oriented; residential above ground floor.
B3-1.5: Community Shopping District - adjusted bulk/density variant.
B3-2: Community Shopping District - moderate intensity retail/service mix.
B3-3: Community Shopping District - higher intensity community retail centers.
B3-5: Community Shopping District - large-scale or regional retail intensity.
C1-1: Neighborhood Commercial District - small-scale business and service uses; taverns/liquor stores by-right.
C1-1.5: Neighborhood Commercial District - adjusted bulk variant.
C1-2: Neighborhood Commercial District - moderate intensity commercial with residential above ground floor.
C1-3: Neighborhood Commercial District - larger scale neighborhood commercial area.
C1-5: Neighborhood Commercial District - highest intensity variant.
C2-1: Motor Vehicle-Related Commercial District - accommodates auto-related and outdoor operations; residential above ground floor.
C2-1.5: Motor Vehicle-Related Commercial District - adjusted density variant.
C2-2: Motor Vehicle-Related Commercial District - moderate intensity auto-oriented area.
C2-3: Motor Vehicle-Related Commercial District - higher intensity variant.
C2-5: Motor Vehicle-Related Commercial District - highest intensity business or commercial zoning.
C3-1: Commercial, Manufacturing and Employment District - accommodates retail, service, commercial, and manufacturing; no residential.
C3-1.5: Commercial, Manufacturing and Employment District - adjusted bulk/density variant.
C3-2: Commercial, Manufacturing and Employment District - moderate intensity employment uses.
C3-3: Commercial, Manufacturing and Employment District - higher intensity commercial/manufacturing mix.
C3-5: Commercial, Manufacturing and Employment District - high-intensity employment district.
D: General Downtown District - applies only to downtown areas.
DC-12: Downtown Core District - high-intensity office/employment hub with mixed uses.
DC-16: Downtown Core District - highest intensity core office/employment area.
DX-3: Downtown Mixed-Use District - lower-intensity office/commercial/residential mix.
DX-5: Downtown Mixed-Use District - moderate-intensity office/commercial/residential mix.
DX-7: Downtown Mixed-Use District - higher-intensity office/commercial/residential mix.
DX-10: Downtown Mixed-Use District - major downtown mixed-use core.
DX-12: Downtown Mixed-Use District - very high-intensity mixed-use zone.
DX-16: Downtown Mixed-Use District - maximum intensity mixed-use core.
DR-3: Downtown Residential District - primarily residential with small-scale commercial on lower floors.
DR-5: Downtown Residential District - moderate-density downtown housing.
DR-7: Downtown Residential District - higher-density downtown housing.
DR-10: Downtown Residential District - high-rise residential downtown area.
DS-3: Downtown Service District - small-scale office, commercial, public, and industrial support uses.
DS-5: Downtown Service District - higher intensity service and support uses.
M: General Manufacturing District - accommodates industrial and employment growth.
M1-1: Limited Manufacturing/Business Park District - low-impact industrial and business park uses.
M1-2: Limited Manufacturing/Business Park District - slightly higher impact industrial uses.
M1-3: Limited Manufacturing/Business Park District - moderate density variant.
M1-4: Limited Manufacturing/Business Park District - higher density manufacturing.
M1-5: Limited Manufacturing/Business Park District - highest intensity enclosed industrial uses.
M2-1: Light Industry District - moderate-impact manufacturing with outdoor operations.
M2-2: Light Industry District - increased scale and land intensity.
M2-3: Light Industry District - general industrial zone for larger operations.
M2-4: Light Industry District - higher intensity industrial.
M2-5: Light Industry District - heaviest light industrial classification.
M3-1: Heavy Industry District - high-impact manufacturing and industrial uses.
M3-2: Heavy Industry District - moderate intensity heavy industrial.
M3-3: Heavy Industry District - standard high-intensity heavy manufacturing.
M3-4: Heavy Industry District - higher intensity heavy industrial area.
M3-5: Heavy Industry District - maximum intensity industrial classification.
POS: Parks and Open Space District - preserves and protects public open space, beaches, and cemeteries.
POS-2: Neighborhood Park, Mini-Park or Playlot sub-district.
POS-3: Open Space or Natural Area sub-district.
T: Transportation District - preserves and enhances transportation corridors.
PMD: Planned Manufacturing District - protects and fosters the city's industrial base.
